observations.explanation: The benchmark evaluates tool-mediated conversations with a simulated user and compares the final database state with a ground-truth outcome; the reward also checks required information in user-facing responses (pp. 2, 4).
The paper reports that for the best-performing tested model, gpt-4o, pass^8 in retail drops below 25% (p. 7).
The authors explicitly remove the domain policy from the function-calling agent’s system prompt and report the resulting pass^1 changes (p. 8).
The paper states that the domains’ schemas, APIs, and rules are simplified relative to real-world domains, and presents this as a benchmark characteristic relevant to generalization (p. 6).
